name: Segment thalamic nuclei
summary: Segments the thalamus into its nuclei with FreeSurfer 7.1.0 segmentThalamicNuclei.sh on an existing FreeSurfer output and returns the FreeSurfer directory with the thalamic nuclei segmentation added.
description: Copies the input FreeSurfer subject directory and runs segmentThalamicNuclei.sh (probabilistic atlas built from histology) to add ThalamicNuclei volumes to mri/. Use it when an analysis needs thalamic nuclei such as the LGN, for example the visual white matter ROI Apps. The input must be a completed recon-all output.

inputs.description: The path to the freesurfer datatype

outputs.description: Output freesurfer datatype including thalamic nuclei segmentation
